title: JSON Key Sorter
h1: JSON Key Sorter — Stable Object Keys
description: Sort JSON object keys alphabetically at every depth and pretty-print the result. Parsing stays in the browser and nothing is uploaded.
intro: Paste a JSON document to rewrite object keys in alphabetical order. Arrays keep their order. Invalid JSON is reported instead of guessed.
blurb: Alphabetize JSON object keys recursively and pretty-print the document.
howItWorks: Paste a JSON object or array.
Press Sort keys. Objects are rebuilt with keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit. Arrays stay in place.
Copy the two-space pretty print. The original text is not changed.
examples: {"b":1,"a":2} becomes an object with a then b.
Nested objects are sorted at every level.
[{"z":1,"a":2}] sorts keys inside the object and keeps the array.

faq.a: No. Only object key order changes. Numbers, strings and array order stay the same. Duplicate keys follow the browser JSON parser, which keeps the last value.

faq.q: Is key order meaningful in JSON?
faq.a: Parsers may ignore object key order. Sorting is still useful for diffs and reviews.
No. Parsing and sorting run in the page.
